issues.display_title: Issue #1986: Fix Numeric Sanitization and Proration Amount Calculation in Storage Addon Checkout
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Investigate and fix a checkout failure when yearly agency subscribers purchase extra storage addons (reported for user_id: 37399), which fails with "Reason for Failure: amount must be numeric" and leaves no entry in cc_logs.

Result

1. Root Cause Analysis

  • Primary Root Cause (Stripe API Rejection):

    • In ccdb.product (Row ID: 28, Plan Name: agencyy_1), the plan_stripe field had an unintended trailing space: 'price_1T9t934UXotNjjkIFe6pDNka ' (31 characters, hex byte ...6b6120).
    • During checkout via POST /v2/payment/subscription/space-addon, the backend passed this un-sanitized string to Stripe's subscription update API ($stripeClient->subscriptions->update(...)), triggering Stripe\Exception\InvalidRequestException: No such price: 'price_1T9t934UXotNjjkIFe6pDNka '.

  • Secondary Root Cause (Error Masking & Missing cc_logs):

    • When the Stripe exception was caught in App\Http\Controllers\Payment\Actions\Stripe\Subscription\SpaceAddon, the handler attempted to record the failed attempt via SpaceAddonHelper::logChangePlanFailure().
    • In app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/SpaceAddonHelper.php (line 199), the 'amount' property passed to LogFailedPayment::fromArray was hardcoded as an empty string: 'amount' => ''.
    • LogFailedPayment strictly enforces numeric amounts: 
      $dto->amount = is_numeric($params['amount']) 
    ? (float)$params['amount'] 
    : throw new \InvalidArgumentException('amount must be numeric');
    • Because is_numeric('') evaluates to false, an uncaught \InvalidArgumentException('amount must be numeric') was thrown. This interrupted the execution before cc_logs could be inserted and masked the original Stripe error in the client response (HTTP 409).

2. Remediation & Database Sanitization

  • Database Fix (ccdb.product):
    • Stripped the trailing whitespace from plan_stripe for product ID 28 (agencyy_1).
    • Verified value: 'price_1T9t934UXotNjjkIFe6pDNka' (30 characters, clean hex ...6b61).
  • Comprehensive DB Audit:
    • Audited all 56 rows in ccdb.product and related tables (plans, stripe_plans, product_prices, cc_produc_names).
    • Confirmed that no other active Stripe or PayPal plan identifiers contain leading or trailing whitespace.

3. Verification & Live API Testing

  • Stripe Live API Retrieval:
    • Tested retrieval directly against Stripe Live API: price_1T9t934UXotNjjkIFe6pDNka $\rightarrow$ 200 OK (Product ID: prod_U89RDEZRjQSPAN, Amount: $1,050.00 USD / year).
  • Upcoming Invoice Proration Calculation:
    • Simulated an upcoming invoice preview for user 37399's subscription (sub_1T6rOP4UXotNjjkIksfts2Ub) using the sanitized price ID.
    • Calculation succeeded without errors: Prorated total of $1,176.54 USD.

issues.display_title: Issue #1987: research(tours): Data research on tour distance calculation and path lengths based on panorama navigation links
issues.main_description_html:
Overview & Goal

Perform data research and feasibility analysis on measuring the real physical distance and path length of virtual tours. The goal is to investigate how to accurately calculate the total distance covered by tours (especially sv_publishing and outdoor tours) using geographical coordinates and actual navigation links, rather than simple sequence order.

Scope of Research

  1. Distance Calculation Methodology:

    • Compare sequence-based traversal (4_panoramas.sequence) vs actual hotspot navigation graph (5_panoramas_links).
    • Identify how branching paths, dead-ends, and loops affect distance metrics.
    • Formulate accurate geodesic distance calculation (Haversine formula) across connected nodes (1_panorama_left $\leftrightarrow$ 2_panorama_right).

  2. Dataset Investigation & Criteria Matching:

    • Sample and analyze real tour datasets in the database.
    • Identify candidate tours with long-distance paths (> 1 km up to multi-kilometer routes).
    • Evaluate data anomalies (e.g. invalid GPS lat/lng, discontinuous jumps, unlinked nodes).

  3. Deliverables:

    • Document calculation logic and edge case considerations.
    • Compile verified list of benchmark tours (> 1 km) with their exact link counts and path lengths.
    • Provide summary data artifact for reference.

Result

Implementation & Investigation Artifacts

  • Commit: 695c94944 on branch main
  • Research Documentation: docs/investigations/2026-10-01-tour-distance-calculation-research.md
  • Raw Benchmark Dataset: docs/investigations/2026-10-01-tour-distance-benchmark-dataset.json

Key Findings & Methodology

  1. Navigation Graph Traversal: Traversal must rely on moderation.5_panoramas_links rather than naive sequential ordering (4_panoramas.sequence). Sequence ordering creates false chord shortcuts on branched paths or dead-end spurs (e.g., +4.69 m distortion at sequence 66 junction in tour GPZ8r7m4).
  2. True Top 10 Longest Virtual Tours (sv_publishing):

    • Rank 6. 6XRq0DKM (150 to 155): 53.30 km | 5,366 panos | 10,238 links | 5.21 m/pano
    • Rank 7. Xc5WVc22 (Extreme Forest Fun): 38.71 km | 3,050 panos | 3,049 links | 12.70 m/pano
